# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 110 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 110 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_110_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 27 — Concluding Exhortation

**1** After a few days the shepherd came to me and said, "Have I not delivered to you the commandments and the similitudes?" "You have, Lord," I said. **2** "Why then have you not yet fulfilled them? For they are needful for you." "Lord," I said, "I do not know what it is that hinders me — there are so many things; I wait, and I cannot fulfill them." **3** "If then you do not fulfill them, you will lose your salvation; for I was sent to save you. But you have not fulfilled what I said to you. **4** But if you live according to my commandments, you shall be saved; and all who live according to these commandments shall be saved, and they shall have life forever." **5** "Lord," I said, "I will carry out whatever you have commanded me; for I know that you were sent for my salvation." **6** "But these things must be kept — by you and by all who shall believe in the Lord their God and walk in his commandments." **7** And he wrote these commandments and similitudes in a book; and he said to me: "Write these commandments and the similitudes you have heard from me, and also the visions you have seen from the beginning." **8** And so he departed from me; and I wept and prayed to the Lord that he would forgive my former sins; and I besought the Lord to complete what he had shown me through his holy shepherd. **9** And the Lord heard my prayer and granted my petition with words of grace.

---

*LOGOS: the book-within-a-book device (v. 7) is the literary self-identification of the Shepherd — this is how Hermas was told to write the document we now read.*
